user.title: Connect to your Envoy
user.description: Enter the Envoy's address and your Enphase Enlighten login. The login is used to get the Envoy's owner token and to read your battery settings.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Envoy on your network.

site.title: Choose the site
site.description: Your Enlighten account has more than one site. Choose the one this Envoy belongs to.

confirm.title: Confirm Envoy {serial}
confirm.description:
Found: {layout} · {hardware}.

The phase layout comes from the Envoy's current transformers and can't be changed here. Check the country and time zone; battery schedules use the site's time zone.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Enlighten again
reauth_confirm.description: Enphase refused the saved login. Enter your Enlighten email and password again.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Envoy or Enphase's servers. Check the host and your network.
error.invalid_auth: Enphase refused the email or password.
error.firmware_unsupported: This Envoy runs firmware older than 7.0, which this integration doesn't support. Use the core Enphase Envoy integration instead.
error.unknown_phase_layout: Couldn't work out whether the site is single-, split- or three-phase from the Envoy's meters. Please open an issue with the Envoy's firmware and meter setup.
error.no_site: Enlighten didn't return a site for this account. Try again in a minute.
error.cloud_unavailable: Couldn't read your battery settings from Enphase's servers. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Envoy is already set up.
abort.wrong_envoy: The host now answers as a different Envoy.

data_description.fast_interval: How often to read live power, battery and grid status from the Envoy.
data_description.stream_interval: Stream readings arrive about every second; this is how often entities are updated from them.
data_description.cloud_interval: How often to read battery settings from Enphase's servers.

phase_layout_changed.title: Envoy phase layout changed
phase_layout_changed.description: The Envoy's meters now report a {detected} layout, but this entry was set up as {stored}. Remove and re-add the integration so the per-phase entities match the new layout.
